fact: Internet Society Pulse (from PeeringDB) lists one active IXP in Madagascar, MGIX in Antananarivo, with 4 members as of February 2026; under 1% of the 7 active domestic networks reach IXPs.

Internet Society Pulse states Madagascar has 1 active IXP, MGIX, at one physical location in Antananarivo, present in 1 of 2 population centres over 300,000, as of February 2026; the origin of members is not stated.
Internet Society Foundation says MGIX, the first Malagasy IXP, suspended operation in 2019; the iRENALA grant of USD 49,958 aims to restart it for a preliminary test period.
Internet Society Foundation grant record says MGIX, Madagascar's first IXP, has been suspended since 2019 and the 2024 grant of USD 49,958 to iRENALA is to restart it.
